transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Um... well, my wife actually thought I should come talk to someone. We've been having some... disagreements lately. 

She keeps saying that her late meetings, and... these little changes in her work messages... she says they're just normal office stuff. But... I don't know. For the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely to feel accidental to me. It's almost like... like there’s a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t just say directly. 

So... I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you ever heard any voices or seen things that other people around you do not seem to notice?
No, I... I haven't experienced anything like that. Just... what I mentioned about the messages. That's all.
Do you find yourself feeling this same level of doubt or suspicion about people other than your wife, such as friends, coworkers, or neighbors?
Um... no. Not really. Just... just with her. I don't... I don't really have any issues with anyone else at work or... or in the neighborhood. It's just what I said before.
Are you absolutely certain that your wife is sending you these secret messages, or have you ever considered that there might be another, more ordinary explanation for them?

Um... well, like I said... I know she claims it's all just normal office stuff. And I've tried to look at it that way, I really have. But... when it’s been happening for a whole year, and things line up that perfectly... it just doesn't feel accidental to me. 

I just... I can't help but feel like it's a private signal she's sending, even if she won't admit it. So... no, I guess I don't really buy the ordinary explanation.
Has this belief about your wife's messages caused you to change how you behave toward her or affected your ability to function in your daily life?

Um... no, my daily life is mostly the same. I mean... I still show up for my teaching sections, and I keep up with the data analysis. I still ride my bike... meet up with some friends for chess. None of that has really changed. 

I guess... the main place it causes any trouble is just at home. We just... we end up getting stuck arguing about what her work schedule really means. But... yeah, other than that, I'm doing everything I normally do.
Aside from your concerns about your wife's messages, have you ever felt like there were other secret plans or hidden meanings in the world around you that were specifically directed at you?
Um... no. Not at all. I don't... I don't think there's any sort of grand conspiracy or anything out there. It's really just... just the situation with my wife. I haven't noticed anything else.
Have you ever spoken to a doctor or a counselor about these concerns regarding your wife's messages at any point before this visit?

Um... well, we did see a couples therapist. That's... actually why I'm here. We were just having so many tense conversations at home about it, and... eventually, the therapist suggested I come in for an individual assessment. But... no, I haven't talked to anyone else about it. Like I said, I'm still working and doing my normal routines just fine. It's really just... an issue between us.
Are you currently feeling depressed, or have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, restless, or like you didn't need to sleep for days at a time?
No... I don't feel depressed. And I sleep normally every night. So... no, nothing like that. My mood is fine.

Have you ever felt the need to take any specific steps, like checking her phone, tracking her location, or recording her conversations, to try and confirm these hidden meanings you feel are in her messages?
No, I... I haven't done any of that. I wouldn't do that. I just... I see what she sends me, and that's enough. I don't need to go snooping around.
When you think about these messages she is sending, do you feel like she is trying to harm you, or is the meaning behind them something else?
Harm me? No, I... I don't think she wants to hurt me. It's just... she's trying to tell me something. I don't know exactly what, but... it's not violent or anything. Just... messages.
